meaning:
συν-ανά-κειμαι
[in LXX: 3Ma.5:39 * ;]
to recline with or together at table: Mat.14:9, Mrk.6:22, Luk.7:49 14:15; with dative of person(s), Mat.9:10, Mrk.2:15, Luk.14:10.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: them which sat with him at meat
they that sat at meat with him
of them that sit at meat
of them that sat at meat with him

elsewhere.note: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed…
Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
